\[
S(A) = \bigcup_{k \ge 0} \left( (A \ominus kB) \setminus (A \ominus kB) \circ B \right)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(A \\ominus kB\): A eroded k times by B
- \(\\circ\): Opening

A eroded k times by B, minus its opening by B, keeps the pixels where a copy of B of size k fits but a larger one does not. The union over k, until the erosion is empty, is the skeleton. Unlike thinning, it may be disconnected, but the shape can be rebuilt from it.
